subject: ColTran: LRB scope decisions
body:
Team,

Decisions for the 7/16 Launch Review Board slot:

1. Demo scope: hosted colorization with the fine-tuned three-stage stack only. The distillation student stays out of the demo — v1 improved to FID 26.9 with the multi-sample target, but that's still visibly behind the teacher, and I won't show it against customer archives yet. It remains our serving-cost path for Q3.
2. Dataset claim: privacy review cleared the second archive 6/22, and Maren got the fine-tune done — we present both datasets, FID 21.3 and 22.7.
3. Latency: we demo the batch (non-interactive) flow and are explicit about it; the interactive story arrives with the student model.

Efe, please get the eval card into Evalline by 7/14 for Nadia's packet.

Lucia
